Obfuscate coefficient values

Source: R/RcppExports.R
dot-obfuscate_coefficients_cpp.Rd

Takes real coefficient values and returns obfuscated values using the affine transform: stored = (real * mult) + offset, where mult and offset are deterministically generated from the obfuscation_key and per-model salts. Used by the developer utility when creating model JSON files.

Usage

.obfuscate_coefficients_cpp(
  real_values,
  obfuscation_key,
  salt_a_hex,
  salt_b_hex
)

Arguments

real_values

Named numeric vector of real coefficient values.

obfuscation_key

Character. 32-character hex string.

salt_a_hex

Character. 16-character hex string (per-model salt A).

salt_b_hex

Character. 16-character hex string (per-model salt B).

Value

Named numeric vector of obfuscated values.
